name: Password Sign-In Requires Passkey
summary: The user submits valid password credentials for a durable identity whose only available MFA method is Passkey; the server returns the generic MFA-required outcome and the client routes directly to the canonical passkey continuation surface.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and an active password-enabled durable identity has Passkey available and no TOTP available for MFA

inputs.name: Email
inputs.description: Prepared test-user email resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Valid password generated by the test setup manager and resolved by the server before the runner plan is returned.

serverInteraction.intent: Submit the password through the normal password-sign-in flow and receive the generic MFA-required server outcome; the one-element available MFA provider set selects Passkey directly.

postconditions.expression: the password proof has succeeded, no authenticated application session is active, and the client has routed the Passkey-only result to auth.continue.passkey

sourceReferences.note: The server returns generic MFA Required with source-supported provider availability.
Angular Web routes Passkey-only MFA metadata to auth.continue.passkey.
React Native converts the Passkey-only response to mfa-passkey before persisting any authenticated session.
React Native routes mfa-passkey to auth.continue.passkey.
Once the handoff reaches auth.continue.passkey, the existing Passkey Sign In behavior owns the remaining ceremony.
A one-element availableMfaProviders list routes directly to that method.
